title: A Yearbook for the Scholarship
author: I. M. Okafor
blurb: Sable Underhill, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
